[b]Why are there no other critters or variations in this mod?[/b]
This is my first mod. This is the first time I made something pixel-y and it took 4 hours for me to try to understand how Custom Critters itself works and then 5 hours because I wasn't happy with how I made my ladybug in the first place. So I will keep it like this for now :3.

[b]How do I install?[/b]
Take the folder named kamalei.ladybug out of the .rar into your Customcritters/Critters folder. If you don't have a folder called "Critters" inside your Custom Critters folder, make one and throw the ladybug in there.
